title: RepoTaskScope (v1)
description: The principal's detached scope for one repository task, bound into a StandingDelegation by subject_binding.

schema.description: Type tag read by verifySubjectBinding; equals the grant's subject_binding.artifact_schema.

repo.description: The repository the change lands in; compared byte-exact with the verifier's expected repository.

base_ref.description: The protected branch the change lands on.

object_format.description: Git object format of the repository; fixes the length of every object id.

items.description: A path the change may add or modify, compared byte-exact with git's path bytes.

allowed_paths.description: Paths the change may add or modify. Unique.

max_changed_files.description: The most entries one change may have.

task.description: The task text the run starts from; the receipt's prompt_hash is hex SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes.
